name: rules-judge
title: Flagging rules that have gone stale
command: ctx rules judge-with CMD && ctx rules judge

conditions.sample: 42 rules the person labelled as still true or stale
conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it
conditions.evidence rule: a flag counts only with a quote found word for word in one of the person's turns

summary: A judge reads a rule beside the person's recent turns and may flag it only with their own words as evidence. Most stale rules are never contradicted in conversation, so recall is low by design; precision is what matters.
bar: no rule that is still true flagged
baseline: the person's own labels of which rules were stale
meaning: The stronger model never flagged a rule that was still true, so it is the one ctx uses. It finds only a few of the stale rules, because most are never contradicted in conversation; a monthly review covers the rest.
